title: Broken left track: carry the toolkit, approach the real shoe and grab its loose end
input_audit: Existing setup explicitly breaks the left-track module, equips the carried toolkit and places the body at the existing 2 m track-repair post. Recording uses ordinary crouch/forward movement, head rotation toward the actual track service point and one ordinary primary-use click. No repair progress or outcome is assigned during recording.
limitations: Staged track failure, not a recorded projectile strike; toolkit pickup is not demonstrated.
Shows the real track shoe, tool and service-point cue plus initial grab only, not completion of the multi-stage repair.
No existing scenario API stages a genuine RingJammed fault and source fragment; ring-fragment visual validation remains separate.
